vector_set: Canonical NDC v2 Profile 1 — adversarial manifest and sidecar descriptions
authority: WS-NDC-2026-11-24-003 digest 417bd4e5e9904d21d2da5905b3ac68905d677f800526eeedcf25fab897ce2119; Profile 1 Decisions A, H and I
note: Described mutations of abstract documents. No mutation is executed here and no release is produced. A rejection token names the expected fail-closed outcome.

cases.operation: change contract_revision in the published manifest after the sidecar was produced
cases.rule: The sidecar digest binds the complete canonical manifest bytes; any post-signing member change breaks the binding.

cases.operation: replace the five-member sidecar manifest_sha256 with a different lowercase 64-hex value
cases.rule: The recomputed canonical manifest digest must equal the sidecar value.
Strict parsing rejects duplicate property names before schema validation.

cases.operation: add a manifest_sha256 member to digests in the manifest
cases.rule: The manifest digest lives only in the detached five-member sidecar; no property is removed or blanked before canonicalization.
The artifacts array is the sole inventory; per-artifact digests live only in artifact descriptors.

cases.operation: add a limits member to the manifest root
cases.rule: The manifest has no limits; a versioned resource policy is enforced independently by both sides.

cases.operation: add a domain member to the sidecar
cases.rule: The sidecar has exactly five members and no domain member; the domain prefix is applied in code.

cases.operation: set sidecar key_id to a value different from publication_identity.signing_key_id
cases.rule: The sidecar key id binds to the manifest publisher and signing key through the out-of-band registry.
